## Pull request overview

Aligns the console’s i18n translation fetch route with the ObjectStack Spec protocol so translation loading works against real backends (not just MSW-mocked environments).

**Changes:**
- Updated `loadLanguage` to fetch translations from `/api/v1/i18n/translations/{locale}`.
- Updated MSW browser + node mock handlers to serve translations from the same spec-aligned route.
- Updated `ROADMAP.md` to remove the stale i18n path reference.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/main.tsx | Fetch i18n bundles from the spec-aligned `/api/v1/i18n/translations/{locale}` endpoint. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/browser.ts | Update MSW browser handler route to match the new i18n translations endpoint. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/server.ts | Update MSW node/test handler route to match the new i18n translations endpoint. |
| ROADMAP.md | Refresh stale roadmap reference to the correct i18n mock endpoint path. |
